configurations.//: Local development. `next dev` loads apps/grow/.env.local FIRST, which points DATABASE_URL at the local grow_local database — so this is the config that gives you a working login. Run `DATABASE_URL=<grow_local url> node apps/grow/scripts/migrate-hub.mjs` once if console pages 500 on a missing table.
configurations.name: grow-hub-dev

configurations.//: Production-mode serve of the last build. NOTE: apps/grow/scripts/start.mjs does `import dotenv/config`, which loads .env (PRODUCTION DATABASE_URL) before Next can read .env.local — so this cannot reach the local database and every console page will 500 on auth. Use it only to check a production build's static output.
configurations.name: grow-hub
